items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: Now, the first time I played a parade, I remember, I played with Red Allen's daddy, old man Allen.

ctx.x: Now, the first time I played a parade, I remember, I played with Red Allen's daddy, old man Allen. Played a funeral across the river. Oh, that's been around 1940, oh, 1940 something. It was in the forties, I know. Yeah. I remember somewhere in 1943, 44, or something like that. I mean, I was playing with, uh, I played a parade with him, a funeral with him across the river. And now I'm telling you, man, that was the first time I met an old man Allen, you see? And a man playing that, that funeral man, the first time…
You can't remember who else was in the band?
